en: Sepia-toned landscape photograph showing a coastal hillside covered with dense vegetation, probably vineyards or low shrubs, sloping down toward a body of water on the left. The coastline curves away into the distance, with a few scattered trees and a small building with a light roof visible at the far right. The card shows age-related stains and damage. At the bottom margin there is a handwritten caption in cursive Cyrillic script.
